title: UNDCSemanticProvenanceContract
description: Enforces immutable data serialization provenance and out-of-band Human-In-The-Loop authorization tracking headers under the UNDC framework.

model_sovereign_id.description: Unique cryptographic identifier of the generating model instance.

blockchain_anchor_hash.description: The block hash or transaction root where the model state is cryptographically anchored.

serialization_timestamp.description: RFC 3339 compliant UTC timestamp of payload generation.

asset_type.description: The abstract structural category of the outbound generative payload.

payload_hash.description: Cryptographic checksum of the serialized payload body to prevent middleman stripping or manipulation.

contains_economic_state_change.description: Must be set to true if the payload attempts API banking calls, smart contract executions, or cryptographic wallet mutations.

proof_of_authority_token.description: Out-of-band cryptographic signature confirming Human-In-The-Loop explicit approval.

validator_public_key.description: The compressed public key of the authoritative human or designated proxy multi-sig.

runtime_enclave_signature.description: The base64 encoded signature of the payload and provenance header, generated inside the isolated hardware enclave runtime.

signature_algorithm.description: The physical cryptographic implementation cipher used to sign the operational envelope.
